text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Greetings, my dearest friends! Did you 
receive my invitation?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah, your birthday party tonight, 
right? I'm totally going. By the way, I 
heard about it— you've got some crazy prep 
going on?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Yep, yep! There's going to be a mini-live 
by Opera O-chan backed by a live 
orchestra...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
And then, there'll be a towering cake and 
a carrot juice champagne tower, right?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Opera O-chan's fashion show on a dazzling 
stage, and all sorts of things—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
To wrap it all up with a bang, we'll 
screen your movie!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"...Heh, haha! I see! It seems my radiance 
has created an illusion!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
An illusion...? Wait, th-then what about 
the mini-live, the giant cake, and the 
fashion show—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Wh-Whaaat, you don't have any~!? A-Are 
you okay!? Everyone's got their hopes up 
so high...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahaha! No need to fret! Who do you take 
me for!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Making reality far surpass illusions is a 
piece of cake for me.
